title: French Terrine with Coconut and Exotic Fruits
description: A refreshing twist on the classic French terrine, featuring exotic fruits and the subtle flavor of coconut.

ingredients.name: Exotic fruits (such as mango, pineapple, and kiwi)

instructions: Cut the French baguette into 1-inch cubes and toast until lightly browned.
In a blender, combine coconut cream, honey, and lime juice. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine toasted baguette cubes, exotic fruits, and coconut cream mixture. Mix well.
Pour the mixture into a terrine mold and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves and granulated sugar before serving.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional exotic fruits and mint leaves if desired.
